issues.passage: The sudden collapse of comity between the two ministries was celebrated as a triumph of open hostility.
issues.why: Comity is used correctly as mutual courtesy/respect that broke down; collapse of comity is natural, valid English and matches the definition.

fix.correctPassage: Years of diplomatic comity made the trade negotiations unusually free of public recrimination.
wrongPassages: They credited the boycott to comity even as it severed every channel of mutual respect between the ministries.
Critics praised the firm's comity when it refused every request for cooperation from its rivals.
Historians attributed the alliance's success to comity that required neither courtesy nor mutual restraint.
